title: 第1014章 庞烈的试探楚峰感悟突破第1013章 修复玄灵界本源道韵中顿悟
content_zh:
道韵洗礼下，楚峰很快便陷入了顿悟之中。
“世界晋级，道韵洗礼，这等万年难得一见的机缘，却被楚峰这小子遇到了……”
庞烈看着顿悟中的楚峰，感叹一声。
当然，这种机缘也是楚峰自己应得的。
若非他将本源碎片都给了玄灵界世界本源，又岂会有如此机缘？
但很快，庞烈的脸色陡然严肃了起来。
“这小子迟早要离开这里，是时候提前做好准备了！”
他并未趁着这个机会修炼感悟。
作为一界之主，玄灵界的晋级，会自动反哺到他，不用修炼，就能提升修为。
他的机缘，不比楚峰差，甚至更好。
飞升通道出口，一个多月过去了，阵法依旧没有动静。
守护在暗中的暗卫已经换成了另外一人。
但没有任何的懈怠。
就在这时，飞升通道出口的阵法忽然亮起。
“有人要飞升了？”
隐藏在暗处的暗卫立刻闪身来到飞升通道出口阵法外等待。
“难道是玄灵界中那该死的人故意引动的阵法？”
迟迟未见有人飞升上来，暗卫心中猜测。
“不管了，我的任务是盯着出口阵法，只要被触动，就通知城主即可。”
随后，他拿出传信符给靖安城城主传去了信息。

几息后，城主带着一队人马赶来。
“怎么回事？”
他看着飞升通道问道。
暗卫将事情详细的说了一遍。
“是他，一定是玄灵界的那位界主！”
靖安城的城主双拳紧握，大声喝道。
很快，他的猜测得到了印证。
飞升通道中传来一道怒骂声：
“哈哈哈，靖西王的走狗们，你爷爷我又来了，是不是很愤怒？
有种你们来打我撒，打我撒……”
庞烈那极具挑衅的声音，气得在场的所有人都脸色铁青。
现场一片寂静，无人敢说话。
但很快，靖安城城主的脸色便恢复了原样。
“这么长时间，他忽然有了动静，说明近期应该有人要飞升了。
我们都在这里盯着，我倒要看看他还能蹦跶多久……”
靖安城城主发话，带着众人守候在飞升通道附近。
然而，阵法刚关闭没多久，庞烈便再度将其触动。
“关闭阵法，等着！”
靖安城城主继续下达命令。
content_en:
Baptized by Dao Yun, Chu Feng soon fell into an epiphany.
"The promotion to the world, the baptism of Tao Yun, this rare opportunity in ten thousand years, was met by this boy Chu Feng..."
Pang Lie looked at Chu Feng who was in enlightenment and sighed.
Of course, Chu Feng himself deserves this opportunity.
If he hadn't given all the fragments of the origin to the origin of the world in the Xuanling Realm, how would there have been such an opportunity?
But soon, Pang Lie's face suddenly turned serious.
"This kid will leave here sooner or later, it's time to prepare in advance!"
He did not take this opportunity to practice enlightenment.
As the master of a realm, advancement in the Xuanling realm will automatically feed back to him, and he can improve his cultivation level without practicing.
His chances are no worse than Chu Feng's, or even better.
At the exit of the ascension channel, more than a month has passed, and there is still no movement in the formation.
The secret guard guarding the place has been replaced by another person.
But there's no slacking off.
At this moment, the formation at the exit of the ascension channel suddenly lit up.
"Is someone going to ascend?"
The secret guard hiding in the dark immediately ducked and waited outside the formation at the exit of the ascension channel.
"Could it be that the damn person in the Xuanling Realm deliberately triggered the formation?"
No one was seen ascending for a long time, so the secret guard made a guess.
"No matter what, my mission is to keep an eye on the exit formation and notify the city lord whenever it is touched."
Then, he took out the messenger talisman and sent a message to the lord of Jingan City.
After a few breaths, the city lord came with a team of people.
"What's going on?"
He asked while looking at the ascension passage.
The secret guard explained the matter in detail.
"It's him, he must be the Realm Master of the Xuanling Realm!"
The city lord of Jingan City clenched his fists and shouted loudly.
Soon, his guess was confirmed.
An angry voice came from the ascension channel:
"Hahaha, the lackeys of King Jingxi, your grandfather and I are here again, aren't you very angry?
If you have the guts, come and beat me up, beat me up..."
Pang Lie's extremely provocative voice made everyone present turn pale with anger.
The scene was silent, no one dared to speak.
But soon, the face of the Lord of Jingan City returned to its original state.
“For such a long time, he suddenly made some noise, which means someone should be ascending in the near future.
We are all here watching, I want to see how long he can keep jumping..."
The Lord of Jingan City spoke and led everyone to wait near the ascension passage.
However, not long after the formation was closed, Pang Lie touched it again.
"Close the formation and wait!"
The Lord of Jingan City continued to issue orders.
